newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Western Australia gets new opposition leader.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Western Australia gets new opposition leader.

text.p: Jim McGinty was replaced by Geoff Gallop as leader of Australian Labor Party in Western Australia on Tuesday following a vote of state Labor politicians.
McGinty said in a statement that the vote was unanimous and followed his approach to Gallop last week to take over the leadership.
McGinty said he had accepted the position of deputy leader.
"In politics, as in life, you must be realistic and honest with yourself," he said.
"In my view, Geoff Gallop will be able to better communicate Labor's message," he said.
The Labor Party is the official opposition in Western Australia, where the government is led by Liberal Premier Richard Court.
